headline: Habagat Rains Expected Over Western Luzon; Brief Reports Saturday College Suspensions in Bulacan
seoTitle: Habagat Over Western Luzon; Bulacan Saturday Class Suspensions Reported
seoDescription: An FMB News brief cites a PAGASA forecast for continued Habagat rains over Western Luzon and reports Saturday college suspensions in Calumpit and Plaridel, Bulacan.
deck: A current GMA weather report cited by the newsroom brief forecasts continued Southwest Monsoon rains over parts of Luzon; the email also reports localized Saturday college suspensions in Calumpit and Plaridel, Bulacan.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The FMB News August 15 overnight brief cites a PAGASA forecast, carried by GMA News, that the Southwest Monsoon will continue bringing rain to Luzon and the western section of the Visayas on Saturday.

The email further reports that Calumpit and Plaridel in Bulacan suspended Saturday tertiary or college classes because of lingering flood conditions. FMB News could not independently retrieve the cited August 15 ABS-CBN service advisory during the final pass, so the municipality-specific suspension details remain source-attributed.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The newsroom brief identifies Zambales and Bataan as areas facing continuing monsoon-rain risk, with scattered rain and thunderstorms also possible across other parts of Luzon. Conditions can change quickly, and local rainfall or flooding may differ substantially from the broad regional forecast.
Class-suspension coverage can vary by school level, institution and locality. Students should rely on the latest announcement from their LGU or school before traveling.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Weekend classes, commuting and flood exposure can be affected even when there is no nationwide suspension. Precise local advisories help families avoid unnecessary travel through flooded roads.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Monitor PAGASA rainfall warnings, Bulacan LGU and school announcements, and local disaster-office updates for any change in flood conditions or class coverage.
